title: As a live blogger having the captions helped me as well. That is what we need to realize. When you exceed accessibility standards you improve learning
summary: As a live blogger having the captions helped me as well. That is what we need to realize. When you exceed accessibility standards you improve learning for everyone, not just those who have a legal right to same access of learning materials. #digped
